name: posters
description: Portable hero posters: `takedown` peels one off the wall (furniture -> rolled item), `putup <poster> [on the left|right|window|door wall]` hangs a carried poster on the wall of the current room (the run moves to that wall) and reports where it falls in the mural; the room's arrange mode hangs carried posters from its Posters menu and drags the run along the walls (`room.sheetStock`, `room.sheetHang`). Two-layer easter egg — Kiyo and Cyd were printed as one image, so hanging that pair together reveals a hidden GRU at the seam on examine; hanging all seven sheets in one room spells HELLMOO across the seams.
